title: Walk-in || Human Resource Payroll Executive
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 22 Sep - 15 Oct
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Kapsons Corporate Office, Sector 17, Chandigarh
Contact: Pallavi (8437509245)

Role & responsibilities Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing for retail stores and corporate employees. Verify attendance, leaves, late marks, overtime, incentives, deductions, and other payroll inputs before salary processing. Maintain accurate employee payroll records and resolve salary-related queries. Coordinate with HR and store teams for new joiners, exits, transfers, promotions, and salary revisions . Process Full & Final Settlements (F&F) for exiting employees. Ensure timely and accurate compliance related to PF, ESI, PT, TDS , and other applicable statutory requirements. Prepare monthly payroll reports, salary statements, MIS, and reconciliation reports. Coordinate with the Finance team for salary disbursement and payroll-related accounting . Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee salary and personal information. Support payroll audits and provide required payroll data and documentation. 

 Preferred candidate profile Graduate in B.Com, BBA, HR, Finance, or a related field . 23 years of relevant experience in payroll processing , preferably in the retail/fashion industry. Strong knowledge of payroll processes, attendance management, and statutory compliances . Good working knowledge of MS Excel and payroll/HRMS software. Strong numerical, analytical, and reconciliation skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to handle high-volume payroll and work within strict timelines. High level of accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

Key Skills: Payroll Management,Benefits Administration,Compensation Management,Statutory Compliance,Attendance Management,Salary Processing,Resource,Statutory
